condition: pd.to_numeric(errors="coerce") on an ArrowDtype string column (e.g. from convert_dtypes(dtype_backend="pyarrow")) turns unparseable values into float nan instead of NA, so isna()/ffill() don't treat them as missing.
workaround: Cast the column to pd.StringDtype("pyarrow") before calling to_numeric, or pass dtype_backend="pyarrow" to to_numeric.
